CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS communication_channel_adapters (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,

    clinic_id BIGINT NOT NULL
        REFERENCES clinics(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    channel TEXT NOT NULL
        CHECK (
            channel IN (
                'whatsapp',
                'sms',
                'email',
                'phone',
                'web_push',
                'in_app'
            )
        ),

    adapter_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    adapter_url TEXT NOT NULL,
    credential_reference TEXT,

    enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,

    request_timeout_seconds INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 30
        CHECK (
            request_timeout_seconds BETWEEN 1 AND 300
        ),

    metadata JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::JSONB,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),

    UNIQUE (
        clinic_id,
        channel
    )
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS outbound_messages (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,

    clinic_id BIGINT NOT NULL
        REFERENCES clinics(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    patient_id BIGINT
        REFERENCES patients(id)
        ON DELETE SET NULL,

    permission_check_id BIGINT
        REFERENCES communication_permission_checks(id)
        ON DELETE SET NULL,

    channel TEXT NOT NULL
        CHECK (
            channel IN (
                'whatsapp',
                'sms',
                'email',
                'phone',
                'web_push',
                'in_app'
            )
        ),

    purpose TEXT NOT NULL
        CHECK (
            purpose IN (
                'appointment_reminder',
                'appointment_update',
                'waitlist_offer',
                'post_visit_followup',
                'clinical_followup',
                'marketing',
                'satisfaction_survey',
                'general_information',
                'human_handoff'
            )
        ),

    message_type TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'text'
        CHECK (
            message_type IN (
                'text',
                'template',
                'media',
                'interactive',
                'email'
            )
        ),

    template_code TEXT,
    language TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'fa'
        CHECK (
            language IN (
                'fa',
                'en',
                'ar',
                'unknown'
            )
        ),

    recipient TEXT NOT NULL,
    subject TEXT,
    message_text TEXT NOT NULL,

    payload JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::JSONB,

    related_entity_type TEXT,
    related_entity_id BIGINT,
    request_reference TEXT,

    idempotency_key TEXT NOT NULL,

    priority INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 5
        CHECK (
            priority BETWEEN 1 AND 9
        ),

    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'queued'
        CHECK (
            status IN (
                'queued',
                'scheduled',
                'processing',
                'accepted',
                'sent',
                'delivered',
                'read',
                'failed',
                'blocked',
                'cancelled',
                'dead_letter'
            )
        ),

    scheduled_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    next_attempt_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),

    attempt_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
        CHECK (
            attempt_count >= 0
        ),

    max_attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 5
        CHECK (
            max_attempts BETWEEN 1 AND 20
        ),

    provider_message_id TEXT,

    last_error_code TEXT,
    last_error_message TEXT,

    accepted_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    sent_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    delivered_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    read_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    failed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),

    UNIQUE (
        clinic_id,
        idempotency_key
    )
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS outbound_message_attempts (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,

    outbound_message_id BIGINT NOT NULL
        REFERENCES outbound_messages(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    attempt_number INTEGER NOT NULL
        CHECK (
            attempt_number >= 1
        ),

    adapter_id BIGINT
        REFERENCES communication_channel_adapters(id)
        ON DELETE SET NULL,

    request_payload JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::JSONB,
    response_payload JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::JSONB,

    result TEXT NOT NULL
        CHECK (
            result IN (
                'accepted',
                'failed',
                'blocked',
                'deferred',
                'adapter_missing',
                'timeout'
            )
        ),

    provider_message_id TEXT,
    error_code TEXT,
    error_message TEXT,

    started_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    completed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),

    UNIQUE (
        outbound_message_id,
        attempt_number
    )
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS communication_delivery_events (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,

    outbound_message_id BIGINT NOT NULL
        REFERENCES outbound_messages(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    provider_message_id TEXT,

    channel TEXT NOT NULL,

    event_type TEXT NOT NULL
        CHECK (
            event_type IN (
                'accepted',
                'sent',
                'delivered',
                'read',
                'failed',
                'undeliverable',
                'rejected',
                'unknown'
            )
        ),

    event_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),

    error_code TEXT,
    error_message TEXT,

    raw_event JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::JSONB,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS outbound_message_dead_letters (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,

    outbound_message_id BIGINT NOT NULL
        REFERENCES outbound_messages(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    final_error_code TEXT,
    final_error_message TEXT,

    attempts_snapshot JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::JSONB,
    message_snapshot JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::JSONB,

    resolved BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    resolved_by TEXT,
    resolution_note TEXT,
    resolved_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),

    UNIQUE (
        outbound_message_id
    )
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_outbound_messages_dispatch
ON outbound_messages(
    status,
    next_attempt_at,
    priority DESC,
    created_at
)
WHERE status IN (
    'queued',
    'scheduled',
    'failed'
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_outbound_messages_patient
ON outbound_messages(
    clinic_id,
    patient_id,
    created_at DESC
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_outbound_messages_provider
ON outbound_messages(
    provider_message_id
)
WHERE provider_message_id IS NOT NULL;

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_outbound_attempts_message
ON outbound_message_attempts(
    outbound_message_id,
    attempt_number DESC
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_delivery_events_message
ON communication_delivery_events(
    outbound_message_id,
    event_at DESC
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_dead_letters_unresolved
ON outbound_message_dead_letters(
    created_at DESC
)
WHERE resolved = FALSE;

SELECT
    TRUE AS success,
    'migration_completed' AS result,
    'ساختار صف پیام، Adapter، Delivery Event، Retry و Dead Letter ایجاد شد.' AS message;

parameters.content:
## فقط یک‌بار اجرا شود

ساختارهای ایجادشده:
- Channel Adapter
- صف پیام خروجی
- تلاش‌های ارسال
- رویدادهای Delivery
- Dead Letter Queue

اطلاعات محرمانه Provider داخل دیتابیس ذخیره نمی‌شود؛ فقط credential_reference ثبت می‌شود.
